**`index.html`** + **`styles.css`** + **`main.js`** — a complete, accessible ecommerce home page for **Lumière**.

### Sections
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| **Announcement bar** | Promo message with deal link |
| **Sticky nav** | Logo, nav links, search, wishlist/cart/account icons, mobile menu |
| **Hero** | Full-width dark banner with headline, CTAs, stats, floating product cards |
| **Category bar** | Scrollable filter chips (Living, Fashion, Tech, Wellness…) |
| **Featured Products** | 8-card grid with badges (New/Hot/Sale/Limited), ratings, wishlist, add-to-cart |
| **Trust strip** | Free shipping, easy returns, secure checkout, 24/7 support, sustainability |
| **Flash Deals** | Asymmetric grid with live countdown timer, animated stock progress bars, discount badges |
| **Editorial / Journal** | Featured article + 2 cards with author bylines and read-more links |
| **Newsletter** | Email signup with submit handler |
| **Footer** | Brand info, social links, 4-column links, legal nav, payment badges |

### Interactive features
- 🛒 Cart badge updates on every "Add to Cart" click, with toast notifications
- ♡ Wishlist toggle per product
- ⏱️ Live countdown timer for flash deals
- 📊 Progress bars animate on scroll into view
- 🎞️ Cards fade in on scroll (IntersectionObserver)
- 📱 Mobile drawer navigation with focus trap & Escape key
- ♿ Full ARIA labels, `role` attributes, skip link, live regions
